definitions.explanation: Kind or well-meaning intentions behind an action. The desire to help or do good for others.
In legal contexts, acting without knowledge of wrongdoing or defect. The opposite of bad faith ({悪意|あくい}).

examples.japanese: {善意|ぜんい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}った→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{善意|ぜんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧にしたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to waste his good intentions.

examples.japanese: {善意|ぜんい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、かえって⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つけて→傷つける：01935_kizutsukeru⟧しまうこと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Actions that come from good intentions can sometimes end up hurting the other person.

examples.japanese: {善意|ぜんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{第三者|だいさんしゃ}→第三者：26789_daisansha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保護|ほご}される→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧。
examples.english: A good-faith third party is protected.

examples.japanese: {買主|かいぬし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{善意|ぜんい}であった⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If the buyer acted in good faith, the contract is valid.

examples.japanese: {善意|ぜんい}・⟦{悪意|あくい}→悪意：19922_akui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{概念|がいねん}→概念：04709_gainen⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The distinction between good faith and bad faith is an important legal concept.

notes:
The antonym is ⟦{悪意|あくい}→悪意：19922_akui⟧ (malice; bad faith). In everyday usage, {善意|ぜんい} means good intentions or kindness. In legal Japanese, it has the specific meaning of 'without knowledge of a defect or wrongdoing,' which differs from its everyday meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {善意|ぜんい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: out of goodwill
- {善意|ぜんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{第三者|だいさんしゃ}→第三者：26789_daisansha⟧: good-faith third party (legal)
- {善意|ぜんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧: to betray someone's goodwill
- {善意|ぜんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}する→解釈する：26837_kaishakusuru⟧: to interpret charitably
